headline: Butterfield Bermuda: Pro-Am wraps Wednesday, Port Royal opens Thursday
whyCareReason: Pro-Am completed Wednesday 21 October. First round is Thursday 22 October. Adam Schenk defends.
teaser: 120 players, $6 million purse, 500 FedExCup points. First round Thursday, Golf Channel 1-4 p.m. ET.
story: Wednesday 21 October concluded the official Pro-Am at Port Royal Golf Course in Southampton, Bermuda. The Butterfield Bermuda Championship begins Thursday, 22 October, running through 25 October 2026. The PGA Tour lists a 120-player field, a $6 million purse, a winner's share of $1.08 million and 500 FedExCup points. The cut is the low 65 and ties after 36 holes. Golf Channel's first-round coverage airs Thursday from 1:00 to 4:00 p.m. ET. Defending champion Adam Schenk leads a field featuring Corey Conners (world No. 61) and amateurs Miles Russell and Mason Howell. Michael Brennan's 16-under Baycurrent Classic win stands as the most recent PGA Tour result. Port Royal is listed at 6,828 yards, par 71.
stakes: The next PGA Tour start is 22 October. Nothing in Bermuda has been scored yet.
rivalryAngle: A full-field test in Bermuda brings FedExCup Fall points back into focus.
